europe_now.title: Ceuta migration aftermath
europe_now.summary: Most migrants who surged into Spain's Ceuta have returned to Morocco, reducing immediate pressure on the border. Local authorities are managing the aftermath while assessing the broader migration flow.

europe_now.title: Greece wildfire toll rises
europe_now.summary: Strong winds have driven wildfires across Greece, increasing the number of casualties and destroyed property. Emergency services are working to contain the blazes and evacuate affected communities.

top_stories.title: Hungary energy crisis
top_stories.summary: A severe drought has lowered Danube River levels, forcing the shutdown of Hungary's Paks nuclear plant. The reduction in nuclear output has triggered an energy crisis, prompting government measures to secure alternative power sources.

top_stories.title: EU emergency meeting on Ceuta
top_stories.summary: The European Union has convened an emergency meeting to address the recent migrant crossings at Ceuta. Officials aim to coordinate a response and evaluate measures to manage migration flows.

top_stories.title: Poland counters anti-Ukrainian violence
top_stories.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has publicly opposed rising anti-Ukrainian violence within the country. His stance seeks to uphold communal harmony and deter further ethnically motivated attacks.
